meta.title: 「显贵」一定不能错过的细节
meta.title_en: Details That Make Clothes Look Expensive

scenes.context: 只要看到这种针脚，那衣服的价格肯定不便宜，这种叫凤尾针。
sentences: 看到这种针脚价格就不便宜。
This kind of stitching signals a high price.
paraphrase: This kind of stitching signals a high price.
scenes.speak: This kind of stitching signals a high price. It's called a feather stitch.

scenes.context: 凤尾针原来多用在旗袍上起固定作用，只能手工缝制，现在多用在这种左右拼接上。
sentences: Feather stitching can only be done by hand.
Now it's used for side seams.
paraphrase: Feather stitching can only be done by hand.
Now it's used for side seams.
scenes.speak: Feather stitching can only be done by hand. Now it's used for side seams.

scenes.context: 表面花纹非常立体、像浮雕式的就叫浮雕大提花，这种工艺相对复杂，价格不会太便宜。
sentences: The pattern is raised like a relief.
paraphrase: The pattern is raised like a relief.
scenes.speak: The pattern is raised like a relief. Complex craftsmanship costs more.

scenes.context: 这种面料除了立体感，最大的优点就是抗皱性非常好。
sentences: Great dimension is one of its strengths.
paraphrase: Great dimension is one of its strengths.
scenes.speak: Great dimension is one of its strengths. It has excellent wrinkle resistance.

scenes.context: 长裙一定要选斜裁面料，瘦点胖点都可以穿，没有紧绷感、包容性更好、垂坠感更好。
sentences: Choose bias-cut fabric for long gowns.
More forgiving, with a better drape.
paraphrase: Choose bias-cut fabric for long gowns.
More forgiving, with a better drape.
scenes.speak: Choose bias-cut fabric for long gowns. More forgiving, with a better drape.

scenes.context: 这种叫流苏工艺，是先将面料做出流苏，再在上面加上固定的线，做出流动感。
sentences: This is called a fringe technique.
为了增加立体度与层次感。
It adds dimension and layers of depth.
paraphrase: This is called a fringe technique.
用layers of depth换一种说法
It adds dimension and layers of depth.
scenes.speak: This is called a fringe technique. It adds dimension and layers of depth.

scenes.context: 流苏让白裙子没有那么单调，买这种裙子为的是设计感。
sentences: It keeps a white dress from looking plain.
买裙子就是为设计买单。
paraphrase: It keeps a white dress from looking plain.
scenes.speak: It keeps a white dress from looking plain. You're paying for the design.

scenes.context: 凤尾针、浮雕提花、斜裁、流苏，这些细节叠加起来，衣服自然显得贵气。
scenes.speak: Layered details read as expensive. Craft complexity drives the price.

practice: 看到凤尾针就知道衣服不便宜。
Feather stitching signals a higher price.
Choose bias-cut fabric for long gowns.
This fabric has excellent wrinkle resistance.
细节决定衣服显不显贵。
Details are what make clothes look expensive.
pitfalls: 以为贵的标志是面料厚
工艺复杂度才是显贵关键
斜裁包容性好、垂坠感强
立体花纹工艺复杂价格更高
觉得白裙子单调就放弃
流苏增加立体度和层次感
